title: A brand worth slowing down for.
alt: Sample Mora Coffee identity board with a green wordmark, monogram and takeaway cup
description: Concept project: a fictional neighbourhood coffee brand, explored through a warm wordmark, a personal monogram and coordinated print applications.
story: This sample identity explores how an unhurried coffee brand could feel across a wordmark, cup, menu and small print pieces. The fictional brief and artwork demonstrate the case-study format and can be replaced with a real Desira project.

caseStudy.brief: Create a welcoming identity for a fictional neighbourhood coffee shop. The sample brief calls for something personal and recognisable, with enough flexibility for cups, menus and a small storefront.
caseStudy.challenge: Make a quiet brand distinctive without relying on a loud colour palette or a complicated symbol.
caseStudy.direction: A compact lowercase wordmark, a simple initial and a green-and-paper palette create a friendly, repeatable visual language.
decisions: A soft serif wordmark gives the name an unhurried feel.
The initial becomes a compact mark for cups and stickers.
A limited palette connects every touchpoint.
caseStudy.applicationAlt: Sample Mora Coffee menu, card and sticker applications

title: Turn the visual volume up.
alt: Sample After Hours event poster with oversized cream typography on navy and coral
description: Concept project: a fictional arts-and-music event, presented through bold poster typography and a coordinated campaign direction.
storyTitle: A clear message, with more energy.
story: This fictional campaign explores how a simple type-led idea can move from a poster to different promotional formats. It is sample content for reviewing the website and does not represent a real client or event.

caseStudy.brief: Develop a bold visual direction for a fictional evening of music and creative culture. The sample artwork needs to communicate the event name quickly and remain recognisable across print and social formats.
caseStudy.challenge: Create impact at a glance while keeping the event name and supporting message easy to read.
caseStudy.direction: Oversized typography and one repeating circular motif give the campaign a strong identity that adapts to different proportions.
decisions: The event name carries the strongest visual weight.
A circular motif adds rhythm without competing with the message.
Navy, coral and cream keep the formats connected.
caseStudy.applicationAlt: Sample After Hours campaign adapted to a landscape poster and a mobile story

title: A little coastal, a lot personal.
alt: Ananya and Chirag’s coastal wedding stationery, featuring a custom AC monogram, palms and seashells
description: A coastal-inspired wedding identity and stationery suite for Ananya and Chirag, with a custom monogram and details drawn from the shore.
storyTitle: Their story. A seaside state of mind.
story: Soft coastal colours, seashells, palms, and a personal monogram bring the couple’s beach wedding vision into one visual world. The project connects invitations and welcome-kit details through a shared design language.

notes: The monogram, palms and shells set one visual language that can carry across the full celebration.

title: Stories you can hold.
alt: Desira’s brochure design combining editorial typography, photography and structured page layouts
description: Brochure design by Desira, pairing photography, clear typography and considered layouts to make information easy to explore.
storyTitle: A considered layout, cover to cover.
story: Print gives a story its own rhythm. This brochure brings photographs, written content, and visual hierarchy together in a format that invites readers to explore the details.

title: Prerna & Rishabh: a celebration illustrated.
alt: Illustrated wedding invitation cover for Prerna and Rishabh
description: A twelve-page invitation world for Prerna and Rishabh, with illustrated venues, ceremony scenes and a changing palette for every celebration.
story: Each event receives its own illustrated setting while floral details, architectural references and a shared typographic rhythm keep the suite connected.

notes: The opening turns the venue into the first piece of the couple's illustrated world.
Every ceremony gets a distinct scene, so guests can recognise the mood before reading the details.
Dates, times and venues stay clear while illustration carries the personality around them.
The palette changes with each event, held together by recurring florals, architecture and fine-line details.

title: From screen to celebration.
alt: The entrance to Toca Boca kids carnival with colourful event signage and graphics by Desira
description: Event graphics for the Toca Boca kids carnival in Chennai, taking Desira’s designs from the screen into a lively real-world celebration.
story: For Toca Boca’s kids carnival in Chennai, the work moved beyond the screen and into the event itself. Colourful graphics helped bring the experience to life, with Desira involved from concept through execution alongside the event team.

title: Tradition, with a personal touch.
alt: A custom invitation by Desira combining floral illustration, traditional motifs and a soft pink palette
description: A custom invitation that brings traditional motifs, floral detail, and a personal visual language together for a meaningful celebration.
storyTitle: Rooted in tradition. Made for today.
story: Cultural detail and a modern composition meet in this invitation project. The result brings the feeling of the occasion into the design through illustration, colour, and careful attention to the brief.

notes: Floral illustration and traditional motifs frame the information without letting ornament overpower it.
